exception: GetVersionAndVendorInfo must not run Mozilla's signature lookup, GetBinaryOrgName, for this build's own unsigned binaries: it can only fall through to the catalog search, which hashes the whole file and walks every system catalog (1.26 s of CPU per launch in the Untrusted Modules thread), for an answer that cannot exist. The statement is a declaration that the lines after it read (signedBy), so no prefix if, guard or if/else can skip it without moving it out of scope. Its text stays verbatim in a thunk handed to StealthSignatureLookupUnlessOwn, which calls it for every other module; for an own binary the answer is null, as the lookup would have returned after its search. Our function reads the version resource itself; the second read of the same file is invisible to a page.

quiet_anchor_why.why: A moz.build registration goes directly after the closing `]` of the UNIFIED_SOURCES list it registers in, and that list is the churning one: Mozilla edits that list and the lines around it in releases 157, 158 and 159. The other places (after an unrelated list, or at the end of the file) are not the list the line registers in.
